# CosmicGrain hypernova yield table
#
# Source: Kobayashi et al. (2006), ApJ 653, 1145, Table 2.
# DOI: 10.1086/508914
#
# This file preserves the published Kobayashi et al. (2006) hypernova grid.
#
# Hypernova explosion energies:
#   M_init = 20 Msun -> E51 = 10
#   M_init = 25 Msun -> E51 = 10
#   M_init = 30 Msun -> E51 = 20
#   M_init = 40 Msun -> E51 = 30
# where E51 = E / 1e51 erg.
#
# Elemental ejecta are isotope sums after radioactive decay:
# C=12C+13C; N=14N+15N; O=16O+17O+18O;
# Ne=20Ne+21Ne+22Ne; Mg=24Mg+25Mg+26Mg;
# Si=28Si+29Si+30Si; Fe=54Fe+56Fe+57Fe+58Fe.
#
# Z_yield_total is computed by summing EVERY tabulated isotope heavier
# than helium (6Li through 74Ge), rather than by subtracting rounded H/He
# entries from the total ejecta.
#
# M_ejecta = M_final - M_cut.
# All masses/yields are in Msun.
#
# NOTE: this is the unmodified 2006 hypernova grid. Any later revised
# models should be documented explicitly rather than silently substituted.
#
# Columns:
# M_init Z_init E51 C_yield N_yield O_yield Ne_yield Mg_yield Si_yield Fe_yield Z_yield_total M_ejecta
